notes.en: [[character:cyno]] is a DPS character that uses his [[ability:burst]] to change stance and deal [[element:electro]] damage. The vast majority of his damage in [[element:stellar-conduct]] teams is from his Duststalker Bolts, so it is very important to time his [[ability:skill]] uses.
notes.fr: [[character:cyno]] est un DPS qui utilise son [[ability:burst]] pour changer de posture et infliger des dégâts [[element:electro]]. La grande majorité de ses dégâts dans les équipes [[element:stellar-conduct]] provient de ses éclairs de sable, il est donc très important d'utiliser son [[ability:skill]] au bon moment.
notes.it: [[character:cyno]] è un DPS che utilizza il [[ability:burst]] per cambiare stato ed infliggere danni [[element:electro]]. La maggioranza del danno inflitto in team [[element:stellar-conduct]] deriva dai suoi 'Dardi del braccatore', quindi è molto importante calcolare bene i tempi di utilizzo della sua [[ability:skill]].
notes.ru: [[character:cyno]] - ДД, способный за счёт [[ability:burst|Взрыва стихии]] менять стойку и наносить [[element:electro]] урон. Подавляющая часть его урона в отрядах через [[element:stellar-conduct]] исходит от Молний бедствия, поэтому очень важно прожимать его [[ability:skill]] вовремя.
